text:
The inextricable and hard bank,

The arduous passage, the voracious maelstrom,

Drag less sand and less impure brushwood


Than our hearts, where the sky is seen;

They are like promontories in the serene air,

Where the lighthouse flashes, beneficent sentinel,

But below are mined by corrosive limpets;


We might compare them still to the lodging,

Hope of the hungry, where at night they knock,

Swearing, wounded, broken, asking asylum,

Prelates and students, whores and soldiers.


They will never return to the filthy bedrooms;

War, science, and love, nothing needs us.

The atrium was frozen, wine and bed infected;

One must serve such visitors on one's knees!

translation.title: Condemnation
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the source's difficult syntax and images of eroded hearts, asylum, and kneeling service.
